rationale: The assistant gave a good safety stop (burning smell, scorching, too hot to keep a hand on) and eventually reached the right conclusion: side condenser warmth is normal, 1cm is tight, check the manual clearances. Along the way it drifted into irrelevant topics (ice, defrost, drain hole, door seal), re-asked the ice question, suggested a 'most likely cause' of dusty coils despite no visible coils and later of automatic defrost, and pasted in garbled template text, which confused the guidance. It also never asked about a warm plug or told the customer to check the manual's exact clearance figure. The ending was vague, and the closing line 'Then no repair is needed' was awkwardly worded.
